cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Use the Proper Title
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I approve the table plan. Change my place card from Jo to Chairperson.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you. Can't I leave it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may keep Jo, provided Chairperson is above it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no room for both on this card. I can make another.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Approved. Give Chairperson its own card, standing in front of Jo. That should make the order clear.

reason: Replace unsupported larger-plate solution with B offered second card; A grants it as a visible hierarchy of title over name.
